crossRefs.note: When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies…
They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and…
He prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please, Yahweh, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I…

translations.web: Yahweh relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen either,” said the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: The LORD repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: Jehovah repented concerning this: this also shall not be, saith the Lord Jehovah.
